summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements, including new frontend pages (BhajanLibrary, VratKatha, HolyBooksAudio, AdminCMS), routing updates, Layout nav/footer updates, Home.tsx CTA cards, new shop category filters in SpiritualShop.tsx, React Query hooks in useQueries.ts, and backend/main.mo extensions. However, several specific acceptance criteria are not fully verifiable from the truncated diff, and some requirements show gaps.

missing_requirements.requirement: Seed at least 20 additional products across four new categories (Rudraksha with 1-mukhi through 14-mukhi + Gauri Shankar/Ganesha/Siddha, Nav Grah Murti 9 items, Nav Grah Yatra 9 items, Devi Devta Yatra 10 items) in the backend (backend/main.mo).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and does not show new product seeding for the four new categories. SpiritualShop.tsx shows PLACEHOLDER_PRODUCTS with some new category items inline, but the requirement specifies backend seeding accessible through getProducts/getProductById. The backend seeding for these 20+ products is not evidenced in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Seed 9 Nav Grah mantras and at least 10 Devi-Devta mantras in the backend devotional content store, each with title, deity, type='Mantra', full Sanskrit text with transliteration, and language tag. These must appear in the existing Devotional Content Library under the Mantras tab.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and does not show seeding of Nav Grah or Devi-Devta mantras in the devotional content store. No changes to DevotionalLibrary.tsx are shown in the diff, so it is unclear whether new mantras appear under the Mantras tab.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must expose updateBhajan(...) and updateVratKatha(...) update functions (in addition to add/delete). Seed initial mock data for all three types in backend/main.mo.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated. It is not possible to confirm that updateBhajan and updateVratKatha are implemented, or that initial mock seed data for bhajans, vrat kathas, and holy book entries is present in the backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: useQueries.ts must export useUpdateBhajan() and useUpdateVratKatha() mutation hooks.
missing_requirements.reason: The useQueries.ts diff is truncated. While useBhajans, useAddBhajan, useDeleteBhajan, useVratKathas, useAddVratKatha, useDeleteVratKatha, useHolyBookEntries, useAddHolyBookEntry, useDeleteHolyBookEntry are referenced in AdminCMS.tsx imports, useUpdateBhajan and useUpdateVratKatha are not confirmed to be exported from the file.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin CMS Vrat Katha Management tab must support edit (not just add/delete) of katha entries.
missing_requirements.reason: The AdminCMS.tsx diff is truncated. The requirement specifies add/edit/delete for Vrat Katha. The visible portion only shows add and delete patterns; edit functionality for VratKatha is not confirmed.

hallucinated_features.description: SpiritualShop.tsx contains a large inline PLACEHOLDER_PRODUCTS array with new category items hard-coded in the frontend rather than fetched from the backend via getProducts.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request requires products to be seeded in the backend and accessible through existing getProducts/getProductById flows. The frontend implementation appears to use static placeholder data instead of backend-sourced products.

hallucinated_features.description: BhajanLibrary.tsx contains a large inline MOCK_BHAJANS array hard-coded in the frontend component rather than being exclusively fetched from the backend via useBhajans().
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-17 and REQ-21 require bhajan entries to be seeded in the backend and fetched via the useBhajans() hook. The frontend also defines mock data locally, which duplicates the backend seeding approach.

hallucinated_features.description: VratKatha.tsx contains a large inline MOCK_KATHAS array hard-coded in the frontend component.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-18 and REQ-21 require katha entries to be seeded in the backend and fetched via useVratKathas(). Having a large static array in the frontend duplicates backend seeding.

hallucinated_features.description: HolyBooksAudio.tsx contains a large inline HOLY_BOOKS constant with all book/chapter data hard-coded in the frontend.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-19 and REQ-21 require holy book entries to be seeded in the backend and fetched via useHolyBookEntries(bookTitle). Having all data statically in the frontend deviates from the backend-driven approach.
